title: Form 10-K Annual Report
description: SEC Form 10-K (10K) extraction contract for filing identity, Parts I-IV disclosures, financial statements, exhibits, and signatures.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: fs-form-10-k
  title: Form 10-K Annual Report
  description: SEC Form 10-K (10K) extraction contract for filing identity, Parts I-IV disclosures, financial statements, exhibits, and signatures; it is not a filing-preparation checklist.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: ladder
    sourceId: standard-financial-services/form-10-k
    sourcePath: https://www.sec.gov/files/form10-k.pdf
    sourceVersion: SEC-1673-02-25
spec:
  documentType: sec_form_10_k
  sections:
    - id: filing-identity
      title: Filing identity and cover
      fieldIds: [registrant-name, cik, commission-file-number, fiscal-year-end, period-of-report, filing-date, accepted-at, accession-number, form-type, amendment-indicator, state-of-incorporation, employer-identification-number-masked, principal-address, registrant-phone, filer-status, emerging-growth-company, shell-company, trading-securities, aggregate-market-value-non-affiliates, shares-outstanding, incorporated-by-reference]
    - id: part-i
      title: Part I
      fieldIds: [business, risk-factors, unresolved-staff-comments, cybersecurity, properties, legal-proceedings, mine-safety-disclosures]
    - id: part-ii
      title: Part II
      fieldIds: [market-and-shareholder-matters, management-discussion-and-analysis, market-risk-disclosures, financial-statements, accountant-changes-or-disagreements, controls-and-procedures, other-information, foreign-jurisdiction-inspection-disclosure]
    - id: part-iii
      title: Part III
      fieldIds: [directors-officers-and-governance, executive-compensation, beneficial-ownership, related-party-transactions-and-independence, principal-accountant-fees]
    - id: part-iv
      title: Part IV, exhibits, and signatures
      fieldIds: [exhibits-and-financial-statement-schedules, form-10-k-summary, auditor-name, auditor-opinion, signatories]
  fields:
    - id: registrant-name
      name: registrant_name
      label: Registrant name
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /cover/registrant_name
    - id: cik
      name: cik
      label: Central Index Key (CIK)
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /cover/cik
    - id: commission-file-number
      name: commission_file_number
      label: Commission file number
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /cover/commission_file_number
    - id: fiscal-year-end
      name: fiscal_year_end
      label: Fiscal year end
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /cover/fiscal_year_end
    - id: period-of-report
      name: period_of_report
      label: Period of report
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /filing/period_of_report
    - id: filing-date
      name: filing_date
      label: Filing date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /filing/filing_date
    - id: accepted-at
      name: accepted_at
      label: Accepted timestamp
      dataType: datetime
      sourcePath: /filing/accepted_at
    - id: accession-number
      name: accession_number
      label: SEC accession number
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /filing/accession_number
    - id: form-type
      name: form_type
      label: Form type
      description: 10-K, 10-K/A, or transition-report designation as stated.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /filing/form_type
    - id: amendment-indicator
      name: amendment_indicator
      label: Amendment indicator
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /filing/amendment_indicator
    - id: state-of-incorporation
      name: state_of_incorporation
      label: State or jurisdiction of incorporation
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /cover/state_of_incorporation
    - id: employer-identification-number-masked
      name: employer_identification_number_masked
      label: Employer identification number (masked)
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /cover/employer_identification_number_masked
    - id: principal-address
      name: principal_address
      label: Principal executive office address
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /cover/principal_address
    - id: registrant-phone
      name: registrant_phone
      label: Registrant phone
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /cover/registrant_phone
    - id: filer-status
      name: filer_status
      label: Filer status
      description: Large accelerated, accelerated, non-accelerated, smaller reporting company, or another indicated status.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /cover/filer_status
    - id: emerging-growth-company
      name: emerging_growth_company
      label: Emerging growth company
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /cover/emerging_growth_company
    - id: shell-company
      name: shell_company
      label: Shell company
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /cover/shell_company
    - id: trading-securities
      name: trading_securities
      label: Registered securities and exchanges
      description: Security title, trading symbol, and exchange rows from the cover page.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /cover/trading_securities
    - id: aggregate-market-value-non-affiliates
      name: aggregate_market_value_non_affiliates
      label: Aggregate market value held by non-affiliates
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /cover/aggregate_market_value_non_affiliates
    - id: shares-outstanding
      name: shares_outstanding
      label: Shares outstanding by class
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /cover/shares_outstanding
    - id: incorporated-by-reference
      name: incorporated_by_reference
      label: Documents incorporated by reference
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /cover/incorporated_by_reference
    - id: business
      name: business
      label: Item 1 — Business
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_1_business
    - id: risk-factors
      name: risk_factors
      label: Item 1A — Risk factors
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_1a_risk_factors
    - id: unresolved-staff-comments
      name: unresolved_staff_comments
      label: Item 1B — Unresolved staff comments
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_1b_unresolved_staff_comments
    - id: cybersecurity
      name: cybersecurity
      label: Item 1C — Cybersecurity
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_1c_cybersecurity
    - id: properties
      name: properties
      label: Item 2 — Properties
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_2_properties
    - id: legal-proceedings
      name: legal_proceedings
      label: Item 3 — Legal proceedings
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_3_legal_proceedings
    - id: mine-safety-disclosures
      name: mine_safety_disclosures
      label: Item 4 — Mine safety disclosures
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_i/item_4_mine_safety_disclosures
    - id: market-and-shareholder-matters
      name: market_and_shareholder_matters
      label: Item 5 — Market and shareholder matters
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_5_market_and_shareholder_matters
    - id: management-discussion-and-analysis
      name: management_discussion_and_analysis
      label: Item 7 — Management’s discussion and analysis
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_7_management_discussion_and_analysis
    - id: market-risk-disclosures
      name: market_risk_disclosures
      label: Item 7A — Market risk disclosures
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_7a_market_risk_disclosures
    - id: financial-statements
      name: financial_statements
      label: Item 8 — Financial statements and supplementary data
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_8_financial_statements
    - id: accountant-changes-or-disagreements
      name: accountant_changes_or_disagreements
      label: Item 9 — Accountant changes or disagreements
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_9_accountant_changes_or_disagreements
    - id: controls-and-procedures
      name: controls_and_procedures
      label: Item 9A — Controls and procedures
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_9a_controls_and_procedures
    - id: other-information
      name: other_information
      label: Item 9B — Other information
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_9b_other_information
    - id: foreign-jurisdiction-inspection-disclosure
      name: foreign_jurisdiction_inspection_disclosure
      label: Item 9C — Foreign jurisdiction inspection disclosure
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_ii/item_9c_foreign_jurisdiction_inspection_disclosure
    - id: directors-officers-and-governance
      name: directors_officers_and_governance
      label: Item 10 — Directors, officers, and governance
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_iii/item_10_directors_officers_and_governance
    - id: executive-compensation
      name: executive_compensation
      label: Item 11 — Executive compensation
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_iii/item_11_executive_compensation
    - id: beneficial-ownership
      name: beneficial_ownership
      label: Item 12 — Beneficial ownership
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_iii/item_12_beneficial_ownership
    - id: related-party-transactions-and-independence
      name: related_party_transactions_and_independence
      label: Item 13 — Related-party transactions and independence
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_iii/item_13_related_party_transactions_and_independence
    - id: principal-accountant-fees
      name: principal_accountant_fees
      label: Item 14 — Principal accountant fees and services
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_iii/item_14_principal_accountant_fees
    - id: exhibits-and-financial-statement-schedules
      name: exhibits_and_financial_statement_schedules
      label: Item 15 — Exhibits and financial statement schedules
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /part_iv/item_15_exhibits_and_financial_statement_schedules
    - id: form-10-k-summary
      name: form_10_k_summary
      label: Item 16 — Form 10-K summary
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /part_iv/item_16_form_10_k_summary
    - id: auditor-name
      name: auditor_name
      label: Independent auditor name
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /financial_statements/auditor_name
    - id: auditor-opinion
      name: auditor_opinion
      label: Auditor opinion
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /financial_statements/auditor_opinion
    - id: signatories
      name: signatories
      label: Signatories
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /signatures/signatories
  validationRules:
    - id: registrant-name-present
      severity: error
      description: The registrant name is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: registrant_name }
    - id: cik-present
      severity: error
      description: The registrant CIK is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: cik }
    - id: period-of-report-present
      severity: error
      description: The period of report is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: period_of_report }
    - id: accession-number-present
      severity: error
      description: The SEC accession number is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: accession_number }
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.9
    fieldConfidence:
      registrant_name: { minConfidence: 0.98, reviewOnBreach: true, regulatoryRequired: true }
      cik: { minConfidence: 0.98, reviewOnBreach: true, regulatoryRequired: true }
      period_of_report: { minConfidence: 0.98, reviewOnBreach: true, regulatoryRequired: true }
      filing_date: { minConfidence: 0.98, reviewOnBreach: true, regulatoryRequired: true }
      accession_number: { minConfidence: 0.98, reviewOnBreach: true, regulatoryRequired: true }
      form_type: { minConfidence: 0.98, reviewOnBreach: true, regulatoryRequired: true }
  outputSchema: {}
  inertSourceMetadata:
    authority: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
    sourceUrl: https://www.sec.gov/files/form10-k.pdf
    scopeNote: Extraction aid only; not a filing-preparation checklist or compliance determination.
